projects.name: SCDOT Programmed Project Lines (October 2023 snapshot)
projects.notes: STALE: the layer was last edited 2023-10-09 and is a one-off export from SCDOT's Programmed Project Viewer, in SCDOT's ArcGIS Online organization. Schema is good: ProjectAct separates planned ('Design/Development', 'Pre-Award') from 'Construction'; ROW_Year and CON_Year are the right-of-way and construction years (0 = none); BudgetCate is the program (e.g. 'Widening & New Location', 'Bridge'); DateOfCurr is the current completion date or 'Currently Undetermined'. There is no cost field. County is in LocationLi. A current, maintained service was not found: SCDOT's own server gis.scdot.org timed out on every request, and the live viewer (https://www.scdot.org/business/projectviewer.aspx) offers a raw data download that was not verified here.

projects.name: SCDOT Programmed Project Points (October 2023 snapshot)
projects.notes: Point companion to the lines layer (bridges, intersections). Same schema and same staleness: last edited October 2023.

parcels_counties.notes: Charleston County's public search map service, layer 'Parcels ***Assessor Maintained***'. OWNER2 is the second owner. Text values are padded with trailing spaces and must be trimmed. No site address and no value field on this layer (SALE_PRICE, RECORDED_DATE, LEGAL_DESCR, CLASS_CODE are present). ACREAGE was 0.0 in the sample.

York County (Rock Hill area; not one of the five most populous, but the only other county verified). Owner2, Owner3, PreviousOwner; AprLandVal / AprBldgVal appraised values; GISSizeAC; DateSold, SalePrice; LandUseDesc.

summary: Projects: only a stale (October 2023) copy of SCDOT's programmed projects could be verified; right fields, no cost, not maintained. Parcels: no statewide layer; Charleston and York county layers with owner and mailing address are verified; Greenville, Richland, Horry and Spartanburg could not be reached.
parcels_statewide_reason: No free statewide South Carolina parcel layer with owner names could be verified. An SCDOT-hosted per-county parcel service was seen in catalog results (smpesri.scdot.org/arcgis/rest/services/GISMapping/SC_Parcels/MapServer) but that server timed out on every request, so its contents are unknown.
parcels_counties_not_found: Greenville (www.gcgis.org), Horry (www.horrycounty.org/parcelapp) and Spartanburg (maps.spartanburgcounty.org) county servers timed out on every request; Richland's guessed server returned 404. None of these four could be verified.
